notes: Keep a minimum touch target and bind the click event through the project scene/component contract.

fallbacks: EditBox with a project-owned validation component
notes: Do not substitute a DOM input or browser-only keyboard API.
Only one renderable component is allowed per Node; split shell, media, and text into child Nodes.
Keep the content Node separate from the viewport and account for layout updates on the next frame.

semanticMappings.preferred: Canvas child + Widget + Layout + Button children
notes: Keep navigation outside the scrolling content and apply safe-area compensation when needed.

layoutCapabilities.scroll: ScrollView with an explicit view and content Node
layoutCapabilities.fixed: Canvas child with Widget alignment; keep outside ScrollView content
layoutCapabilities.overlay: Node sibling order and zIndex/local position
layoutCapabilities.grid: Layout component with GRID type and explicit constraint
layoutCapabilities.safeArea: SafeArea component or Widget plus project safe-area policy
layoutCapabilities.keyboard: EditBox focus plus project keyboard/viewport policy; no DOM assumptions
layoutCapabilities.responsive: Canvas design resolution with one proportional adaptation mode per orientation; validate portrait, landscape, and safe content bounds
layoutCapabilities.defaultAdaptationPolicy: Use fit_width for portrait HUDs and fit_height for landscape HUDs unless the project explicitly requires show_all or no_border.
layoutCapabilities.distortion: Never scale X and Y independently; ExactFit-style distortion is rejected
layoutCapabilities.breakpoints: Use a small number of aspect-ratio/orientation variants only; do not emit CSS-like per-device-pixel breakpoints

stateMappings.loading: project loading Node or state Component

eventMappings.itemSelected: Button click event with stable item data

accessibilityMappings.role: Preserve semantic role in component metadata; Cocos UI is not a DOM/ARIA tree
accessibilityMappings.label: Visible Label plus platform/project accessibility bridge when available
accessibilityMappings.value: Component state and visible value Label
accessibilityMappings.hint: Visible helper/error Label and project accessibility metadata

assetHandling.runtimeReference: SpriteFrame or project asset reference; do not emit base64/data URLs
assetHandling.bitmap: Prefer imported SpriteFrame and preserve source crop/anchor metadata
assetHandling.vector: Rasterize to PNG for the default portable path unless the project has a verified vector pipeline
assetHandling.naming: Use stable names and avoid replacing existing project assets

commands: Run the project through its configured Cocos Creator 3.x editor/build command
Run the project's TypeScript/lint checks when configured
runtimeChecks: selected proportional adaptation mode and no unintended distortion
16:9 landscape, 19.5:9 portrait, 4:3 tablet, and an extreme-aspect-ratio device
safe area and fixed bottom navigation
EditBox focus, validation, keyboard and boundary values

visualReview.capture: Use the project's Cocos Creator preview or native build screenshot path
visualReview.compare: scripts/compare_screenshots.js when the project exposes a captured PNG
visualReview.textOverflowCheck: Check Label overflow mode, line height, component bounds, and runtime text measurement in the target project

rejectWhen: target is treated as DOM, React, UIKit, SwiftUI, or Android View code
UI node is emitted without Canvas/design-resolution assumptions
fit width and fit height are enabled together without an explicit show_all policy
X and Y are scaled independently or ExactFit-style distortion is used
a device-pixel-specific breakpoint is added without an orientation/aspect-ratio rationale
content controls are positioned against the physical screen instead of the safe content area
a single Node contains multiple renderable components that should be separate Nodes
layout depends on CSS flex/grid or an unverified third-party layout runtime
ScrollView content and viewport are not represented separately
fixed navigation or CTA is placed inside scrolling content without an explicit product requirement
runtime code assumes Layout results are available immediately after mutation
asset is referenced by a base64/data URL or a path outside the Cocos assets pipeline
interaction has no Button/Node event mapping and no validation/error state
